title: ACADS tension crack, reference crack depth 3.6 m (results correspond to a dry crack)

meta.title: ACADS tension crack, reference crack depth 3.6 m (results correspond to a dry crack)
meta.notes: ACADS 1(b) as a commercial program models it: c′ = 32 kPa, φ′ = 10°, a 3.6 m tension crack (dry); critical-circle search.

source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V047b (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: Entry on the crest (x = 49.9–55.2) and exit at the toe (x = 26.9–30.2), as in the source.
The manual quotes 'about 3.6 m' for 2c/(γ√Ka); the formula gives 3.814 m (V048 uses 3.814). commercial program B Janbu (uncorrected) 1.471. ACADS band 1.65–1.70.

The text says the crack is water-filled, but commercial program B's 1.664 / 1.660 are reproduced only with a DRY 3.6 m crack (cSlope 1.658 / 1.655). With the crack full of water cSlope gives 1.593 / 1.589 (3.6 m) and 1.589 / 1.586 (3.814 m, = V048; commercial program A 1.596 / 1.592). Without a crack 1.685 / 1.683.
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.
grieta de tracción: profundidad 3.6 m, fracción de agua 0 (cSlope tensionCrackDepth y tensionCrackWater); en ogs es `analysis.tension_crack {depth, water_fill}` (F5.2).
